While he waited for an answer, he kept the lamp burning and watched the grey horizon.","w02":"凌晨四点，街道空得能听见信号灯切换时的轻响。便利店仍亮着，店员正把热包子摆上柜台。清洁车缓缓驶过，留下潮湿的路面。高楼只有零星几扇窗透出灯光；远处的车站，一名旅客拖着箱子等第一班车。天色尚未发白，城市却已有人开始工作。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by using a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a box and finding a smaller box inside, then opening that one too.\n- You need a stopping point: when there are no more boxes, you stop."}
